_source: Board, jobs, reputation, season summary and awards (decided Oct 7-8: negotiable objectives with rewards scaled by stakes - high risk, high reward; a board-confidence meter; sacking leads to offers from lower clubs, never game over; job offers scale with reputation, up to 3 a season; you can apply to clubs, acceptance not guaranteed; the new club keeps its squad; the wage bar is set by the board from reputation and league level, the ambitious objective raises it, and you can ask for more mid-season with a probability; WSC-style awards; season summary screen). All numbers are PROPOSALS (Oct 9 night).
_objectiveNote: Each season the board offers 3 objectives for the league: safe (finish no lower than the expected place + a margin), standard (the expected place) and ambitious (expected - margin). Expected place = the club's rank in its league by squad strength. Margin = max(2, teams/6). The objective sets the wage bar (finance.json objectiveMultipliers) and the stakes. Chosen before the league starts (week 9); standard if you don't choose.
_confidenceNote: Board confidence 0-100, starts at 60. League results: +0.6 a win, -0.6 a loss. Every 4 weeks: on or above the target +1, below it -0.5 per place (at most -3). Fan mood pushes it a little: (mood - 50) / 50 x 0.3 a week. A club at zero money: -1 a week.
_sackNote: Sacked mid-season below 15 confidence (from week 20), or at the end of the season below 25. Then 2-3 offers from lower clubs; until you accept one, the world plays on without you.
_reputationNote: Manager reputation 1-100. Starts at 20 + half the club's reputation. Objective met/missed (above); league title +6, domestic cup +3, continental cup +8, promotion +4, relegation -6, sacked -8.
_jobsNote: Season end: up to 3 offers from clubs whose reputation is within your reputation - 10 ... + 10 (better managers get better clubs), each club 35% likely to call. After a sacking: 2-3 offers from clubs below your old club. Applying: chance = 0.5 + (your reputation - club reputation) / 40, from 5% to 95%.
_wageNote: Asking the board for more wage room mid-season: chance = 0.7 - 2 x extra share + 0.3 x (confidence/100 - 0.5), from 5% to 95%. Once a season.
_awardsNote: Every league: Player of the Season (best average rating, 60%+ of the club's league matches), Golden Boot (most goals), Top Assists, Young Player (21 or under, 40%+ of matches), Goalkeeper of the Season (most clean sheets). World: Golden Ball (best average rating in all competitions, top divisions, 30+ matches) and World Golden Boot (most goals in all competitions).
